### 3. Model Edge & Valuation
- **KANDERSON**: Model P(YES) ~99% vs Market 99.5%. No edge — must close NO to cap loss.
- **KXCABLEAVE**: Model P(YES) ~10% vs Market 12%. No actionable edge. Holding YES at 0.14 entry has marginally better EV than closing at 0.90 NO ask (-$0.02/contract EV vs -$0.04 locked-in close loss). Let it resolve.
- **Close P&L math (KANDERSON)**: 1186.9 × (1.00 - 0.64 - 1.00) = 1186.9 × (-0.64) = -$759.59 realized loss + fees. Matches cost basis.

### 4. Catalysts & Invalidation
- **Key Catalysts / Dates**: KXCABLEAVE resolution Sep 1, 2026 (10 days). Any surprise Cabinet resignation announcement in next 10 days would invalidate my hold thesis.
- **Invalidation Trigger**: KXCABLEAVE — a confirmed Cabinet secretary resignation announcement between now and Sep 1, 2026 (excluding Gabbard, acting roles, and Press Secretary). KANDERSON — N/A (already settled).

**Net cycle action**: Close KANDERSON NO to crystallize the locked-in loss; hold KXCABLEAVE YES to resolution since closing now is slightly worse EV than letting it expire. No new positions taken — FARIAS lacks catalyst, Fed/Bitcoin markets lack research edge this cycle.
